svg.title: The eight regions of Sim Wrestling
svg.desc: Mid-Atlantic is active in blue: Delaware, Maryland, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Seven planned regions appear in muted colors. Alaska and Hawaii are unassigned. The complete region and state list follows the map.
